idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In Telangana, 53.2% of women aged 15 to 49 worked in the past year and were paid in cash (NFHS-6, 2023-24): the highest of 34 ranked states and UTs, ahead of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu (48.0% each), against India's 30.8%. In NFHS-5 Telangana also led, at 45.1%.
Survey estimates. Blank: Manipur (no NFHS-6 fact sheet yet) and Lakshadweep (small sample). The table shows how much, not why.
source: International Institute for Population Sciences, National Family Health Survey: NFHS-6 (2023-24) state fact sheets (total, urban and rural columns), which also print the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure. Indicator: women aged 15 to 49 paid in cash for work, as labelled in the fact sheet. 34 states and UTs with data; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no NFHS-6 sheet yet.
